scope: One fixed switch from thresholded to posterior expected nominal service scoring. Existing PP records only; no new trained model, data collection, simulation, horizon/threshold sweep or independent confirmation.
cohort: Identical other-city8h source, each local block2h, three disjoint blocks, six reused dev seeds percity, no owncity donor fit.
predictor: Frozen count-evidence fusion CT+CH with one physical prior; same features, labels, conditional cells and physically stratified placebo.
only_change: ForT/S/P service columns, accumulate each flight raw posteriorCDF. Keep endpoint10 hard decoded perflight at0.5 before summation. Physical history/analytic service indicators and recordedGP unchanged.
expected_nominal_score: queue_base13_j + sum_f sum_h protected_mask_jfh * F_f(min(10,max(0,h-tail_f))), h=1..13. Linearity needs no independent-vehicle assumption.
same_call_hard_control: From each same raw flightCDF also reconstruct hard_forecasts (allTSP columns>=0.5 before edge aggregation), exactly previous13s predictor. Never threshold summed edge expected counts.
frozen_controls: Bothscopes everyseed: five endpointpoint MAEs, edge denominator, all15pairs oldhard13 requests total/unlocked and oldS-minus-T/P/GP PP-label score sums exactly reproduce. Newhistory/analytic/GP pair requests must also stay unchanged.
state_and_window: Reuse exact previousPP state-string recovery and13s queue/mask reconstruction; all original rows retained; locked/fallback relative gains structuralzero.
primary_mask: Original common-scored riskset; pointMAE then equally weighted six complete seeds percity. All-decision andunlocked action denominators retained.
secondary_mask: All observable matched nonspillback moving-flight epochs, separately reported.
diagnostics: After allhard/soft actions fixed, PP arrivals lag<=10 plus same tail enter nominal13 label score. Report S-minus-T/P/history/GP raw net, positive/negative sums andepochs, meanperallTLSdecision then equal seeds. Same-label oracle regret is algebraically related, not independent evidence.
gate: Original bothcity S<T/P/history endpointpointMAE and sourceST/SP softscore request differences in>=2devseeds each; no additional proxy pass gate and no posthoc relaxation.
branch_time_diagnostic: Retain source action differences in60..3150s but do not substitute this for original full-decision gate.
stopping: If failed HOLD_EXPECTED_SERVICE_DEVELOPMENT; if passed DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY. No automatic native branch orconfirmation in this offline step.
interpretation: Expected score is conditional on fitted PP-arrival distribution and static queues/nominal13s hold; candidate actions can alter arrivals, so neither proxy nor oracle is actual counterfactual traffic cost.
execution: jtl110gpu2. Pull compact summaries only; raw records and model counts stay server-side.
